rules.description: SYN connection attempt to the synchronisation service.
Manifest marker bytes are present; decode and correlate the complete manifest separately.
SHA-256 marker bytes are present; verify the full digest and file contents separately.

rules.filter: tcp.port==5010 && (frame contains "PUSH" || frame contains "PULL" || frame contains "GET" || frame contains "PUT")
rules.description: Push/pull operation marker bytes are present; assert the actual synchronisation result.
FIN/RST transport-closure frames are present; verify the application closure reason.

manual_checks: R1 R2 R3: Decode the selected framing and compare paths, sizes and complete hashes.
R4 R5: Assert final contents and the chosen conflict policy, including the explicitly permitted handling of the losing version.
